title: French Wrap with Kinako Flair
description: A modern twist on traditional French cuisine, combining the crunch of kinako and the softness of a wrap. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the German butter and let it melt.
Add the sliced apple and cook until caramelized.
In a small bowl, mix together the kinako, cinnamon, and sugar.
Add the kinako mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the kinako mixture on the wrap, followed by the caramelized apple.
Drizzle with honey and fold the wrap in half.
